semantic_adjudication.basis: Dossier 0052:r3:i0: contract NL-CONTRACT-NL1-INITIAL-ENTRY-1 (requirement_quote, property=initial_entry, owner=root, target=Operate); closed model inventory of root-scope transitions (lines 23-26); transition:line:24 ([*] -> Off); author PlantUML line 3 ([*] --> Off); source inventory tr_0001 (@initial:__root__ -> Off); model transition Off -> Operate (line:25).
semantic_adjudication.reason: The contract as authored specifies property=initial_entry, owner=root, target=Operate. The complete finite root-scope transition inventory (lines 23-26 of scope llms_emp_feedback_final_0052) contains exactly one initial pseudostate edge: [*] -> Off (transition:line:24). No edge [*] -> Operate exists. This is an exact negative inventory result establishing the required edge is absent, so grounding is established. However, the NL requirement quote 'Once the device is powered on, the system enters the Operate state' is genuinely ambiguous between (a) the absolute initial entry goes to Operate, and (b) after the power-on event the system transitions into Operate from its true initial state Off. The author's own model draws [*] --> Off in the PlantUML source (line:3) and the source inventory tr_0001 confirms the initial target is Off, while an Off -> Operate transition exists (line:25). These exact facts support the event-triggered reading as a competent alternative semantic interpretation of the same NL clause, making this an undercutting defeater that survives.
semantic_adjudication.strongest_defeater: The NL phrase 'Once the device is powered on, the system enters the Operate state' admits a second reading in which 'powered on' is a triggering event (not the absolute initial state), Off is the true initial state representing the device before power-on, and Operate is the first operational state reached via a power-on transition from Off. The author's PlantUML explicitly draws [*] --> Off and the model includes Off -> Operate (line:25), supporting this event-triggered reading over the initial-entry reading.
semantic_adjudication.violated_obligation: The contract NL-CONTRACT-NL1-INITIAL-ENTRY-1 requires a root-scope initial pseudostate edge [*] -> Operate so the system enters Operate as its initial operational state upon power-on, but the complete root-scope transition inventory contains only [*] -> Off as the sole initial edge.
